scenario.opening_question: What matters most for our office coffee: cost, flavor variety, convenience, or sustainability?

options.name: Blue Bottle Single-Origin Subscription

options.name: Trade Coffee Variety Pack Subscription

options.tradeoff: Less control over specific bean origins or roast profiles
options.concern: Variety may include some coffees not everyone likes

options.name: Peet's Coffee Classic Blend Subscription

options.name: Atlas Coffee Sustainable Organic Subscription

options.tradeoff: Slightly higher cost and limited flavor variety
options.concern: Some may prefer bolder or less mild flavor profiles
